chars.RACHID: RACHID: a young Moroccan man about 25, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, faded blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.GIRL: SAMIRA: a glamorous young Moroccan woman, long straight brown hair, red satin dress, gold hoop earrings
chars.SLIMANE: SLIMANE: a rich Moroccan man in his fifties, slicked-back grey hair, neatly trimmed grey beard, cream linen suit with open white shirt, gold watch

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a chic modern café in Casablanca. In the foreground RACHID sits at a small table with a coffee, staring openly with his mouth half open at SAMIRA who is walking in arm in arm with SLIMANE; SLIMANE notices and gives RACHID a suspicious side glance. Comic, tense mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same café in Casablanca. SAMIRA, seated at a table across the room, looks back over her shoulder at RACHID with a sly little smile; RACHID at his table is surprised and flattered, pointing at himself as if asking 'me?'.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same café. In the background SLIMANE walks away toward the counter; in the foreground RACHID gets up from his chair and walks confidently toward SAMIRA's table, adjusting his hoodie, cheeky grin.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same café. RACHID leans over SAMIRA's table, holding out his phone and smiling charmingly, asking for her number; SAMIRA, seated, raises an eyebrow, amused and a bit nervous.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same café. SLIMANE stands right behind RACHID, tall and serious, one hand in his pocket, looking down at him; RACHID freezes mid-sentence with wide scared eyes, phone still in hand; SAMIRA looks down embarrassed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same café, close two-shot. SLIMANE, calm and mysterious, studies RACHID up and down with narrowed eyes as if evaluating him; RACHID swallows nervously, sweating, forced smile.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same café. SLIMANE leans toward RACHID with a strange knowing smile, gesturing with an open hand toward SAMIRA as if asking 'do you like her?'; RACHID is deeply embarrassed, scratching the back of his head, looking away; SAMIRA sits sipping her drink.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Sidewalk outside the café on a sunny Casablanca street with palm trees and white buildings. RACHID is walking away; SLIMANE has caught up and holds out a small business card to him with a confident smile; RACHID turns, confused.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: A Casablanca street corner at dusk. RACHID stands alone holding a small business card, frowning at it with a very puzzled, suspicious expression, one eyebrow raised, the café visible behind him.
